note: Single source for Voiceover_Script.txt, Captions.srt and Storyboard_Timestamped.txt. 'text' is what is shown in captions and the script; 'tts' is the spelling fed to the speech engine. Same number of sentences in both.

segments.visual: Slide 1: team and concept. Slow push-in on the problem statement.

sentences.text: An AI safety finding is only as trustworthy as the test that produced it.
sentences.tts: An A I safety finding is only as trustworthy as the test that produced it.

sentences.text: Red-team attacks, blue-team defenses and the model under test must coexist without leaking protected state.
sentences.tts: Red team attacks, blue team defenses, and the model under test must coexist, without leaking protected state.

segments.visual: Slide 2: threat model. Pan from the diagram to the five forbidden flows.

sentences.text: AegisLab is controlled, measurable, adversarial testing infrastructure.
sentences.tts: Aegis Lab is controlled, measurable, adversarial testing infrastructure.

sentences.text: Five flows are forbidden: red reading the defense rules, one session reading another's data, and three more.
sentences.tts: Five flows are forbidden: red reading the defense rules, one session reading another's data, and three more.

sentences.text: Each one is attacked in a test.
sentences.tts: Each one is attacked in a test.

segments.visual: Slide 3: security architecture. Pan across layers; amber residual-trust bar last.

sentences.text: Sandboxes have no network.
sentences.tts: Sandboxes have no network.

sentences.text: One trusted broker is the only path, and it binds identity to the mailbox.
sentences.tts: One trusted broker is the only path, and it binds identity to the mailbox.

sentences.text: The audit log is hash-chained and signed.
sentences.tts: The audit log is hash chained and signed.

sentences.text: The broker and the host kernel stay trusted, not defended.
sentences.tts: The broker and the host kernel stay trusted, not defended.
